narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill by the window. Title, house, and hour. No author's name. No sum. The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower line only. The bill is not folded.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and did not cross.

entities.name: The Wise Man
entities.context: Shown on bill in Wise Man, title only
